scientific_question: Are the rapid ring reclosures in M6.6 (31/76 within 10 ticks for either opening) compatible with the ordinary per-adjacent-candidate bond formation probability p=0.05, without invoking emergent directed repair?
inspiration: M6.6 preregistered secondary: 31/76 opened arms reclose within 10 ticks, compared with naive fully eligible contact benchmark 1-(1-0.05)^10 ≈0.4013. This is post-discovery hypothesis tested on NEW SEEDS.

prespecified_source.parent_geometry: Unmodified M6.4 natural start 24x24 periodic, initial zero bonds
prespecified_source.selection: First two distinct 4-cycle material ID sets in each world, in first detection tick then sorted material ID order; no replacement or resampling. No pre-existing synthetic scaffolds.
prespecified_source.allowed_source_edits: NONE. Intervention only in cloned state through M6.5 open_bond which redistributes stored bond energy, then full native physics.

null_model.formula: 1-(1-0.05)**10, a NAIVE Bernoulli contact benchmark assuming an eligible bond-formation trial each tick, no competing reactions, no occlusion and no loss of ring geometry.
null_model.caveat: Reference is NOT an exact null for real crowded worlds: competing bonds, energy decay, ruptures, and eligibility reduce or change contact opportunities. No p-values for dependent forks. The event audit is needed to evaluate opportunities and reasons for deviations.
null_model.kinetic_target: An event of kind=form linking the artificially opened source ID pair (regardless of later breaks), not a 4-cycle topology snapshot; both reported separately.
null_model.energetic_constraint: The intervention conserves entire world's instantaneous energy but changes its distribution and frees two valences; do not claim pure topology causality.

measurements.primary: For each density and each opening arm, fraction of naturally created ring forks having a native BondEvent(kind=form) of the target original edge by tick 10.
secondary: Fraction with exact same-source 4-cycle seen at any snapshot in ticks 1..10
Fraction with target edge reformed but not full original ring (other original edges may break)
First target edge reformation tick; exact event count and chronological event trace for source bonds

Fraction of 10-tick observation windows (before first target reformation) in which target edge is a STATIC chemistry candidate at pre-step snapshot, evaluated read-only with chemistry._candidate_pairs, subject to per-step movement/break confound
Number of selected worlds and zero-case worlds; per-precursor-world distinct fork counts
Original full hash and PCG64 RNG fingerprint/draws at fork, after each arm; replay for first selected fork of first seed in each density without observer must match event-instrumented result
All 160 possible opened trajectories (less if no rings) in raw JSON
measurements.interpretation: An edge reforming in a graphically persistent chain after an ordinary allowed chemical bond event is NOT self-repair, copying or metabolism. If fully eligible contact benchmark approximates measured rate, that's evidence against a special extra repair mechanism, not proof of model completeness.

decision.no_statistical_tests: Do not use confidence levels or tests of significance; this is a preregistered descriptive diagnostic with correlated selections.

integrity.repeatability: For first chosen fork in first seed of each density, fork and rerun native world without observer 10 ticks; final full hash, RNG draw count, energy and total formed/broken counts must match observer run.
